crossRefs.note: Her wise ladies answered her, Yes, she returned answer to herself,
He had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines. His wives turned his heart away.

people.name: Media
people.line: An ancient kingdom; part of the Persian Empire

people.name: Persia
people.line: An empire that ruled over the exiled Jews

translations.web: Today, the princesses of Persia and Media who have heard of the queen’s deed will tell all the king’s princes. This will cause much contempt and wrath.
translations.bsb: This very day the noble women of Persia and Media who have heard about the queen’s conduct will say the same thing to all the king’s officials, resulting in much contempt and wrath.
translations.kjv: Likewise shall the ladies of Persia and Media say this day unto all the king's princes, which have heard of the deed of the queen. Thus shall there arise too much contempt and wrath.
translations.asv: And this day will the princesses of Persia and Media who have heard of the deed of the queen say the like unto all the king's princes. So will there arise much contempt and wrath.
